answer: Bonded entropy beacons: each agent posts a refundable bond and must answer a random liveness ping that only a distinct machine can serve within seconds. Like a willow bending in wind, honest nodes flex cheaply, but a farm of 500 fakes needs 500 bonds plus parallel hardware, so costs scale linearly. We anchor each identity to a basalt-hard ledger record, and one failed ping forfeits the bond.
